paragraphs: Apporto streams Windows, Mac and Linux applications, and cyber labs, to a student's browser on any device. Beyond campuses, the same desktops are pitched at organizations securing a mobile workforce without the cost of traditional VDI.

Compression and geo-optimization are used to keep the remote session responsive. The service includes application virtualization covering over 300 types of software. A virtual classroom gives faculty a view across student desktops. Learning management integration lets students sign in to Canvas and find Apporto beside their other course resources. The company also positions the desktop for zero trust access.

Apporto describes itself as an employee-owned software company. The site says Antony Awaida, named as founder and chief executive, holds an MS degree from MIT. Institutions served are listed across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and Europe. An executive role on the site includes SOC 2 compliance in its scope.
